This is a beginner-friendly guide where you’ll learn how to go from zero to creating high-quality AI videos using Motion Control, reference images, and prompt workflows.

🔥 In this video, you’ll learn:
• How to use Kling 3 inside a visual workflow  
• How Motion Control works with reference image + video  
• How to connect prompt, import, and model blocks properly  
• How to use Element for character consistency  
• How to generate multiple videos using Kling 2.6 (credit-saving method)  
• Full workflow setup from start to finish  

This tutorial is perfect for creators who want better results using:
Kling AI, Motion Control, Image-to-Video, Fal AI, and AI video automation tools.

If you're struggling with Kling setup or wasting credits — this method will save you time AND money.
